messages.subject: Using median_hillow categorically
parts:
Hi all,

I'm new and had a question. How can I use the median_hillow function
so that this statistical summary is computed for unique factors ? My
data frame, R.RE.fish, looks like:

RE year sim
1 -75.775856 -29 80
2 8.340446 -28 80
3 -554.680951 -27 80
4 -129.596555 -26 80
5 -77.463661 -25 80
6 -113.342122 -24 80
. . . . .
29995 -127.26363 55 60
29996 -254.00132 56 60
29997 -91.19654 57 60
29998 -100.67343 58 60
29999 -101.62247 59 60
30000 -42.23358 60 60

but when I run this command :

m <- ggplot(R.RE.fish, aes(year, RE, colour=factor(sim)))
m + stat_summary(fun.data = "median_hilow", conf.int=.9, geom =
"smooth", lwd=1)

I get three trajectories according to the factor sim, but notice that
these statistical summaries are computed across levels of that
factor. I would like "median_hilow" to be applied to each level of
the sim factor, not across all 3.

Any help would be great.

Thanks.

- Tommy
